title: Knox Baird et al. v. Grace Presbytery
disposition_detail: The jointly decided complaints in Cases 2023-06 and 2023-08 were sustained on Issues 1 and 2, sustained in part on Issue 3, sustained on Issue 4, denied on Issue 5, and sustained on Issue 6; Issue 7 was not reached. The directive for additional personal communications was vacated, the trial stay was annulled, and the Session trials were to proceed.
first_summary: Session elders challenged Presbytery’s handling of a moot mediation complaint, document and congregational-notice directives, BCO 40-5 reports, and a stay of pending trials. The SJC sustained the complaints in the main, holding that the mediation complaint was never formally filed and became moot, Presbytery could not compel personal communications or require the Session to address the congregation, and the stay lacked the required prior citation. It denied the challenge to assigning the BCO 40-5 reports to a committee and did not reach alleged partiality.
summary: Session elders challenged Presbytery’s handling of a mediation complaint, investigative directives, BCO 40-5 reports, and a trial stay. The SJC held that the mediation complaint was never formally filed and became moot; official-record requests were proper, but compelling nonrecord personal communications and requiring the Session to address its congregation exceeded Presbytery’s authority. It vacated the communications directive and annulled the stay for lack of the required prior citation. It upheld committee examination of the BCO 40-5 reports and did not reach alleged partiality; the Session trials were to proceed.

evidence_notes.identity_and_adoption: Cases 2023-06 and 2023-08 were complaints jointly heard and decided by the SJC; the final decision was approved 17-0. Lines 9–17, 29, 406–408.
evidence_notes.dispute: The elders challenged the Blue Hen commission proceedings, information and congregational-notice directives, committee review of BCO 40-5 reports, and the stay of Session trials. Lines 139–157.
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: Issue-level judgments appear at lines 158–166; reasons and relief appear at lines 170–181, 214–324, and 326–404.
evidence_notes.qualifications: Official court-record requests were proper; the ruling did not address use of correspondence obtained by a prosecutor or demands unrelated to pending charges. Issue 7 was not reached. Lines 214–225, 310–324, 396–404. The concurrence concerned brief decorum, not the merits. Lines 423–446.
evidence_notes.incorporated_decisions: No external decision was incorporated by reference; the panel’s reasoning was unanimously adopted by the SJC. Lines 406–408.
